style: Using exactly the art style, pixel density, proportions, dark outlines and shading of the attached character sheet (16-bit pixel art of a mid-1990s console role-playing game),
key: The background is flat solid magenta #FF00FF everywhere, with no floor, pedestal, shadow, frame, border, title, label, number or text of any kind.
grid: Each panel is a full painted scene filling its cell edge to edge, separated from its neighbours by straight black gutters, with no frame, border, title, label, number or text of any kind.

sheets.lead: draw these eight characters again as a clean sheet: the same faces, hair, outfits and weapons as in the attached sheet, each in a three-quarter view facing left in a ready battle stance, full body, arranged in an even grid of 4 columns and 2 rows with wide empty gutters, each one whole and not touching the others or the edges.
items: Top row, first: a young knight with short brown hair in silver plate armour and a blue tabard, holding a longsword.
Top row, second: a woman with long wild black hair in a crimson coat over bronze armour, a greatsword over her shoulder.
Top row, third: a ranger with a long auburn braid in a green hood and leathers, drawing a bow.
Top row, fourth: a bearded man in a fur-collared brown cloak and leather armour, holding a tall spear with a cloth banner.
Bottom row, first: a broad bearded shipwright in a blue bandana and leather harness, a heavy double-bladed axe on his shoulder.
Bottom row, second: a lean fighter with messy dark hair in a white sleeveless top and dark trousers, wrapped fists raised.
Bottom row, third: a seer with long dark hair in white and gold robes, holding a glowing slender sword.
Bottom row, fourth: a hard-faced man in a black hood and dark mail, holding a dark greatsword low.

sheets.lead: draw five huge boss monsters, each far larger and more detailed than a person, arranged as 3 in the top row and 2 in the bottom row with wide empty gutters, each one whole and not touching the others or the edges, facing right.
items: The Ashen Tyrant: a towering armoured warlord of black iron and glowing forge cracks, a crown of chains, a burning hammer.
The Drowned King: a bloated grey-green corpse king in a rusted crown, seaweed hair, a coral and timber throne, pale glowing eyes.
The Thousand-Eyed Court: a floating masked figure in layered violet robes covered in open eyes, ribbons of illusion around it.
The Hollow Saint: a tall empty saint's robe with a cracked golden halo and no face, pale corrupted light spilling from inside.
The Iron Horde: a giant war-beast of riveted iron plates ridden by a horned warlord, banners and spears bristling from its back.

sheets.lead: draw five elite monsters, each about twice the height of a person, arranged as 3 in the top row and 2 in the bottom row with wide empty gutters, each one whole and not touching the others or the edges, facing right.
items: The Smith of Chains: a hunched giant blacksmith with an anvil-shaped head, chains wrapped round both arms, glowing coals in his chest.
The Tidewarden: a drowned knight in barnacled plate holding a trident, water pouring from the joints of his armour.
The Herald: a thin jester-herald in violet and gold with a long trumpet and a smiling mask, a second face on the back of its head.
The Penitent: a kneeling armoured flagellant with a cage over its head and a censer of pale fire, scourges hanging from its belt.
The Warlord: a huge horned warrior in spiked iron armour with a tower shield and a heavy cleaver.

sheets.lead: draw sixteen separate item icons laid flat, arranged in an even grid of 4 columns and 4 rows with wide empty gutters, each one whole and not touching the others or the edges.
items: Wintermark, a pale steel sword with a frost-blue blade and a silver guard.
A black greatsword with violet runes.
A heavy axe whose head is a barnacled ship's anchor.
A spear with a long cloth banner.
A tall longbow of dark yew with a green grip.
A pair of cloth hand wraps.
A pair of iron knuckle gauntlets.
A bundle of green healing herbs tied with string.
A small glass vial of green antidote.
A glowing red and gold phoenix feather.
A folded letter with a red wax seal.

sheets.lead: draw four battle panels in an even grid of 2 columns and 2 rows, each panel landscape, using the same characters as the attached sheet.
items: Top left, Cross Slash: the young knight in silver plate cuts twice in an X of pale blue light across a monster, in a stone dungeon.
Top right, Skewer: the bearded spearman lunges, his spear running through two monsters in a row, on a grassy hillside.
Bottom left, Rain of Arrows: the hooded ranger looses a volley that falls as a storm of arrows on a pack of wolves, in a forest clearing.
Bottom right, Fire Wall: the white-robed seer raises a hand and a wall of flame rises between the heroes and charging monsters, in a ruined hall.

sheets.lead: draw four battle panels in an even grid of 2 columns and 2 rows, each panel landscape, using the same characters as the attached sheet.
items: Top left, Mending Rain: soft glowing blue rain falls on four wounded heroes, closing their wounds, on a stone bridge.
Top right, Stone Skin: the broad bearded axeman's skin turns to grey stone as a monster's claws glance off him, in a cave.
Bottom left, Imperial Wedge: four heroes in a wedge formation, the armoured knight at the point with shield raised, on an open field.
Bottom right, Tortoise: four heroes crouched close behind locked shields as arrows rain down on them, at a castle gate.

Bottom row, fourth, the Forgeborn Knight: a tall knight hammered from one piece of black iron, flames behind the visor, large, about twice the height of a person.
